ai.title: Fix CLI agent and message conversion tests
ai.summary: Updated `local-agents.test.ts` and `messages.test.ts` to align with current implementation behavior. Agent registry tests now account for bundled agents appearing when no local directory exists, checking for absence of test-prefixed agents instead of null returns. Message conversion test expects empty string output for empty tool results instead of placeholder text.

eli5.text: The automated checks that verify the tool works correctly have been updated to match how the tool actually behaves now. If you ever inspect these checks, you'll see that tests which previously expected the tool to report "null" or a placeholder message for empty results now expect an empty string or bundled agents even without a local directory. These are behind-the-scenes maintenance updates to keep the verification process accurate; no live user behavior changes today.

ai.title: Remove Ctrl+U debug logging from multiline input
ai.summary: Deleted `logger.debug` call and unused import in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. The logging statement tracked cursor position and line start calculations during Ctrl+U keypresses. This cleanup reduces noise in the CLI debug output without altering input handling logic.

eli5.text: If you use the command-line assistant and press Ctrl+U to erase to the start of the line, you won't see any new hidden debug entries in the tool's internal logs. The developers removed the special logging they used to track cursor math during that keystroke, which were only visible to people actively debugging. You probably never noticed these messages, so the deletion cleans up the background output without changing how the shortcut works.

ai.title: code-reviewer-lite added to free agents
ai.summary: Added `code-reviewer-lite` entry to `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Maps the new agent to `minimax/minimax-m2.5`. Provides free access to code review functionality.

eli5.text: If you use the service without a paid account, you can now get help reviewing source code through a lighter-weight version of the code review feature. It draws on the same underlying model as the editor tool, so the quality should feel familiar, and it appears alongside the other free tools you already have access to. The change is already in place, so you can try it out the next time you open the free mode.
